Justice KENNEDY delivered the opinion of the Court.
The classic example of a property taking by the government is when the property has been occupied or otherwise seized. In the case now before the Court, petitioners contend that governmental entities took their real property-an undeveloped residential lot-not by some physical occupation but instead by enacting burdensome regulations that forbid its improvement or separate sale be

Justice THOMAS, dissenting.
